verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q (Shock Blast) poke on cooldown without minion cover; you win every all-in from level 6 on once Jayce commits Hammer Stance.

brief.thesis: Jayce wants to poke from range with Cannon Stance and kite, but Malphite's entire kit is a point-blank burst that only works at melee range — so the whole lane is a fight over whether you reach him before he reaches 6 items of poke. Malphite vs Jayce sits at 56.8% over 7,479 games specifically because once R (Unstoppable Force) comes online at 6, Jayce has no form that survives a knock-up into E (Ground Slam) into W (Brutal Strikes).

theirWindow.when: He's in Cannon Stance at range
theirWindow.what: He's sitting on Q (Shock Blast) and E (Acceleration Gate) to poke you for free; don't walk up into open space, stand behind a minion wave so Shock Blast detonates early.

yourWindow.when: He swaps to Hammer Stance to trade
yourWindow.what: This is Jayce choosing melee range — close immediately with Q (Seismic Shard) to steal his speed, then E (Ground Slam) and W (Brutal Strikes) before he can swap back to Cannon and disengage.

powerCurve.note: Cannon Stance poke, you have no answer yet
Q (Seismic Shard) lets you punish overextends
Sunfire/Thornmail make trades unwinnable for him
he scales into teamfight poke, you're a pick threat

start.why: Jayce's whole early plan is chip damage from Cannon Stance autos and Shock Blast; Doran's Shield's sustain and poke-reduction directly counters that plan while you wait for level 6.

boots.why: 80% pick for a reason — Jayce's damage is entirely physical (both stances auto-attack and his Q/E scale off AD), so flat auto-attack reduction shuts down his poke harder than tenacity does.

core.why: Gives you the HP and armor to force trades at range-zero where Jayce has no tools, and the burn punishes him for standing near you even passively
Jayce has no sustained heal, so grievous wounds plus the armor spike makes his AD scaling nearly worthless once you're both level 11+
The attack speed slow directly neuters his Cannon Stance W (Hyper Charge) attack-speed burst and his basic poke rotation

situational.when: he builds burst magic items or rushes Lich Bane-style magic damage to punish your lack of MR
he's ahead and you need a stacking stat-check item to survive his poke into the fight

runes.keystoneWhy: Comet rewards exactly the trade pattern you want — landing Q (Seismic Shard) on him as he commits to a poke auto or Shock Blast, punishing his aggression before he can disengage

summoners.why: Teleport is run in 72.8% of games here and lets you skip the losing early poke phase by recalling and TPing back once your level 6 all-in threat is live, while Flash covers your Unstoppable Force engage timing against his dash.

playing.title: Hold minions as cover pre-6
playing.detail: Shock Blast (Q, Cannon Stance) travels in a line and detonates on the first thing it hits — stand behind your wave so a minion eats it, not you.

playing.title: Punish every Hammer Stance swap
playing.detail: When Jayce swaps to Hammer, he's giving up range to threaten E (Thundering Blow) knockback or Q (To the Skies!) leap — step up with your own Q (Seismic Shard) the instant you see the swap animation.

playing.title: All-in the moment R is up at 6
playing.detail: Unstoppable Force has an 8s travel-adjusted 130s cooldown at rank 1 but you only need one — knock him up, E (Ground Slam) immediately, then W (Brutal Strikes) to finish; no Jayce stance survives that chain pre-11.

playing.title: Track his mana for Hammer Stance
playing.detail: Lightning Field (W, Hammer Stance) restores mana per strike passively — if his bar looks low he's forced into Cannon Stance longer, which is your cue to shove the wave and threaten a recall.

playing.title: Don't chase Cannon Stance kiting
playing.detail: You have no gap closer besides R on a long cooldown — if he's kiting in Cannon Stance post-fight, let him go and reset rather than eating a Shock Blast at full range.

playing.title: Use W for extended skirmishes, not pokes
playing.detail: Brutal Strikes (W) only pays off once you're already in his face hitting multiple attacks — pop it as you commit to the all-in, not as a poke tool, since it doesn't deal damage on its own.

playing.title: Build toward Thornmail as your powerspike
playing.detail: Since Jayce has zero sustain, Thornmail's grievous wounds effectively deletes any late-game 1v1 equity he has left — prioritize it the moment he starts building lifesteal or healing items.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and win rates above are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis of the ability kits, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Jayce’s ranged pokes and his hammer form combo to avoid losing health. Stick behind minions to dodge his (E)-(Q) combo.
